description: The line plot titled "Whisper fine-tuning, type = tiny" illustrates the performance of different configurations of the Whisper model over a series of epochs during the fine-tuning process. The x-axis, labeled "epoch," is linear and ranges from 0 to 6, with tick labels at every integer value. The y-axis, labeled "WER," is also linear and ranges from 30 to 70, with tick labels at intervals of 10. The plot includes five lines, each representing a different configuration of the Whisper model: tiny AdaLoRA_int4, tiny AdaLoRA_int8, tiny int4, tiny int8, and tiny full. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 line is represented by a solid line with diamond markers, the tiny AdaLoRA_int8 by a dashed line with square markers, the tiny int4 by a dash-dot line with circle markers, the tiny int8 by a dotted line with triangle markers, and the tiny full by a solid line with no markers. All lines show a general downward trend, indicating a decrease in WER as the number of epochs increases. The tiny AdaLoRA_int4 configuration starts with the highest WER at epoch 0 and ends with the lowest WER at epoch 6, while the tiny full configuration starts with the lowest WER and ends with a slightly higher WER than the other configurations. The other configurations show varying degrees of improvement over the epochs, with the tiny int4 and tiny int8 configurations ending with the lowest WERs at epoch 6.
